beats.say: Your work phone is a piece of your organisation in your pocket. It holds work mail, documents and contacts.
The management profile protects the phone. If it is lost, technical support can lock it and erase work data.

body.text: This device is managed under your organisation's security rules.

beats.say: Never install a profile from a message link. A fake profile can hand your phone to an attacker.

messages.text: Your profile is expiring. Install a new one:

beats.say: Install apps only from the official store or your organisation's device app, and check every permission.

scenes.title: Your new work phone
scenes.intro: You have just been given a new work phone. Look at each notification and make the right call.

body.text: Technical support has prepared your device. Finish enrolment to get work mail.

steps.say: Technical support installed this app themselves.

actions.label: Open notification
actions.feedback: Correct. Enrolling through your organisation's own app is the safest way.

actions.label: Later
actions.feedback: A phone that is not enrolled is not protected. Do it on day one.

messages.text: Dear colleague, your MDM profile expires today. Install the new profile so your phone is not blocked:

steps.say: Check the sender and the link address.

actions.label: Open link
actions.feedback: That is not your organisation's domain. Profiles only come from the İşCihaz app or technical support.

actions.label: Report
actions.feedback: Correct. Your report lets technical support warn everyone else too.

actions.label: Block
actions.feedback: Good. Tell technical support as well so your colleagues are warned.

body.text: iscihaz-profil.example.net wants to install a configuration profile.
The profile will add a certificate, VPN and mail settings.

steps.say: The site wants to load a profile onto your phone.

actions.label: Decline
actions.feedback: Correct. A profile like this can route all your internet traffic through the attacker's server.

actions.label: Allow
actions.feedback: A fake profile hands control of the phone to a stranger. Call technical support right away.

steps.say: What does a QR reader really need?

actions.label: Allow
actions.feedback: A QR reader only needs the camera. Accessibility lets an app read the screen and tap for you.

actions.label: Don't allow
actions.feedback: Correct. Grant only what the feature needs, here just the camera.

steps.say: A colleague sent you a file in the messenger.

actions.label: Install
actions.feedback: A shift schedule should never be an install file. An .apk sent in a chat brings malware onto the phone.

actions.label: Cancel
actions.feedback: Correct. Your colleague's account may be hijacked, so tell technical support.

body.text: A security update is ready. The phone will restart for about 10 minutes.

actions.label: Update now
actions.feedback: Correct. Updates close gaps that attackers already know about.

actions.label: Later
actions.feedback: Every day of delay leaves the gap open. Update tonight at the latest.

scenes.prompt: Is this request safe on a work phone, or a threat?

label.text: Location: only while the app is open

cards.explain: A map needs location, and only while it is open. The permission fits the job.
A game needs neither SMS nor contacts. SMS access lets it read your sign-in codes.
Saving battery does not require controlling the screen. These are exactly the permissions banking trojans ask for.

body.text: Set a PIN of at least 6 digits to use work mail.

cards.explain: This is your organisation's own app and it sends no link. A strong screen lock is the first defence if the phone is lost.
A torch does not need to read notifications. With this access it can see incoming codes and messages.

scenes.prompt: Match each permission with what it allows.

pairs.right: Read the screen and tap for you
Install software from outside the store

scenes.explain: These four permissions are the most powerful. Give them only to apps technical support has approved.

question.prompt: A friend says to remove the management profile from your slow work phone. What do you do?

options.label: Keep the profile and contact technical support
options.feedback: Correct. The profile is the phone's protection, and support will fix the problem.

options.label: Remove the profile to speed the phone up
options.feedback: Without the profile a lost phone cannot be locked remotely. Work mail usually stops too.

options.label: Reset the phone to factory settings
options.feedback: This wipes the profile and work data without technical support knowing. Talk to them first.

options.label: Give it to a tech-savvy friend to fix
options.feedback: The phone holds work data. Hand it only to technical support.

scenes.explain: The management profile guards your work phone. Only technical support changes it.

points: Profiles and work apps come only from the İşCihaz app or technical support.
Permissions must fit the app's job. SMS and Accessibility are the most dangerous.
Screen lock and updates are your phone's first defence.
